description: Receive a delivery against an issued purchase order, line by line — the Receiving page. For each line give the units that arrived (partial is fine) and, for a short shipment, the units to record as missing. Received units go into stock at the item's default location or a location you name, with lot / expiry / serials for tracked items; cost layers, the receiving journal entry and backorder release happen as in the UI. Receiving more than was ordered needs confirmOverReceive=true and is only possible when the tenant allows over-receiving. The preview shows ordered, already received, receiving now and remaining per line, plus the base-unit quantity and cost that land in stock. Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt. Call get_purchase_order_receiving first for lineIds. Omit lines to receive everything still open on every line ("it all arrived") into each item's default location; tracked items still need their lot or serials, so name those lines. A draft order must be issued before it can be received.

confirmOverReceive.description: Set true only after the user agreed to receive more than was ordered on a line.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lines.description: Lines to receive (max 200). All lines commit together or not at all. Omit (or pass an empty list) to receive every remaining unit on every line.

lineId.description: Purchase-order line id (GUID) from get_purchase_order_receiving. Either lineId or sku is required.

location.description: Put-away location name, code, barcode or id in the destination warehouse. Optional: defaults to the item's default location, then the warehouse's receiving location.

quantityMissing.description: Units to record as missing (short-shipped) on this line in addition to any already recorded, in the order line's unit of measure (>= 0).

quantityReceived.description: Units that arrived, in the order line's unit of measure (>= 0). Leave 0 to only record missing units.

serials.description: Serial numbers, for serial-tracked items (one per unit).

sku.description: Item SKU on the order; must match exactly one open line.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is received until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

purchaseOrder.description: Purchase order id (GUID), document number (e.g. PO-2026-10-000118), or the short form people use for an open order: its last digits ("118", "PO 118").

receiptInput.description: Echo the receiptInput returned by preview on commit and retries. It is hash-bound to the receipt; do not edit it.

name: receive_purchase_order
title: Receive Purchase Order
